title: What to Wear to an Outdoor Session
author: Wren Alder
summary: A short, unfussy guide. The main advice is good shoes.
content:
Wear what you'd wear on a good day out. That's most of it. A few things help:

  • Plain, soft colors sit well against forest and water.
  • Avoid big logos, and matching outfits unless you love them.
  • Bring proper shoes. We'll be walking.
  • Pack one warm layer. The best light comes when the sun has nearly gone.

If you're not sure, send me a photo of a few options. I'm always happy to look.
